title: UBAG Worker Daemon Job-End Marker (protocol v1 + opt-in v2)
description: The single terminal control line a warm worker daemon writes to stdout after a job (mirrors JOB_END in daemon_protocol.py and daemonJobEndKey in daemonrunner.go). Every job emits exactly one marker. The v1 fields (__ubag_job_end__, job_id, status completed|failed, error, reason) are unchanged. Every field added by protocol v2 is optional and is only emitted when the request line carried proto:2; a daemon replying to a v1 request MUST NOT emit them. The marker is control, not an event: events stay verbatim job-event objects and the marker never reaches the job event log. A stream that ends without a marker means the daemon died and the job failed; a consumer never treats the events collected so far as a complete result. The control_reply definition below is the opt-in answer to one control line (see worker-daemon-request.schema.json).

status.description: timed_out is v2-only (decision D4: a deadline-cut stream ends timed_out with data.partial on the terminal event, never completed). A v1 request still gets failed + reason worker_deadline_exceeded.

error.description: Human-readable failure summary; never raw provider output or secrets.

pid.description: Daemon process id, for supervisor correlation only.

warm_key.description: Lowercase hex hash of the warm-page key (provider + physical session identity). It MUST be a one-way hash: never a raw profile path, user_data_dir, CDP endpoint, or identity_ref.

outcome_signal.description: Coarse health signal for the supervisor and readiness logic: drift (selector baseline no longer matches), manual_action (provider needs a human), captcha (challenge shown; safe-mode never solves it), timeout, none. Detection only; it never triggers automated login or CAPTCHA solving.

submitted.description: True once the prompt was submitted to the provider. Once true the attempt MUST NOT be blindly resubmitted: a failure after submission is failed with reconcile_required on the terminal event (ADR-0007).

control_reply.title: control reply (opt-in, answers one control line)

features.description: hello only: capabilities this daemon implements. A sender must not rely on a feature that is not listed.

state.description: probe only: whether the daemon is between jobs.
